annotations.title: Read a curated view from a connected external source

description: Run one pre-approved, read-only view against an external data source connected to this client (e.g. the agency's copywriting frameworks or ad data). Call list_context_sources first to see the view keys and which columns you may filter on. You cannot reach anything the view does not expose.

client.description: Name, @handle, or UUID of the client.

filters.description: Equality filters. Only columns listed as filterable on the view are accepted.

search.description: Free-text match across the view's filterable columns.

source.description: Source name, only needed when two sources share a view key.

name: query_context_source
title: Read a curated view from a connected external source
